title: Rav Kahana, Father-in-Law of Rav Mesharshiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Bava Batra 97b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.97b.10), Rav Kahana asks Rava a question. In [Ketubot 100b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.100b.17), he has beer belonging to Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai, an orphan. Hyman suggests that this may be the same Rav Kahana.[^1]

notes.text: Bava Batra explicitly calls Kahana Rav Mesharshiya’s father-in-law, as does [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2296&lang=en). Ketubot names the orphan and Kahana without specifying that relationship.
